mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because the resulting picture connects the cell parts to muscle shortening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making cell fluid was straightforward but contributed less explanation than the later constructions.

surprise.text: I initially expected membrane fats to combine with water; the compatibility feedback instead showed that transport proteins were needed to make the selective membrane.

arbitrary.text: The initial membrane recipe was not obvious to me, although the result explained why channels matter.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the progression from cell parts to muscle fibers made me curious how the fibers will be organized into working tissues.
